questions.question: What are the three main parts of a story?
questions.explanation: Every story has a beginning (where we meet the characters), a middle (where something happens), and an end (where the problem is solved).

questions.question: What does "context" mean when reading?
options: The words around a word you dont know
questions.explanation: Context means the words around a word you dont know. You can use context to guess what a new word means.

questions.question: Kva betyr "hungry" på norsk?
questions.explanation: "Hungry" betyr svolten. If you are hungry, you want food.

questions.question: Beføre you read a story, you should:
options: Look at the pictures and read the title
questions.explanation: Beføre reading, look at the pictures and the title. This helps you guess what the story might be about.

questions.question: Kva betyr "garden" på norsk?
questions.explanation: "Garden" betyr hage. A garden is where you can grow flowers and plants.
